verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's Composer and MCP server let an AI agent draft campaigns/content and 'map out the send strategy' while explicitly keeping the human 'in control' for review before work is carried through, and the Campaigns API lets agents create campaign objects programmatically. However, there's no explicit documentation of a queued/scheduled-for-approval state or workflow gating send until human sign-off. missing for 10: explicit approval/queue mechanism in campaign API docs, hands-on confirmation that AI-drafted campaigns default to draft/scheduled (not auto-sent) status.
